speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. Since the infant has bilious vomiting and failed to pass meconium, this is a surgical emergency; can you tell me exactly how many hours of age the baby was when the vomiting started?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-day-old male infant. The infant was born via a home birth without complications. The mother reports that the infant has had bilious vomiting and has not been able to pass meconium since birth. She also notes that the infant's abdomen appears distended.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung Disease (with potential distal obstruction mimicking malrotation, though the failure to pass meconium is the hallmark of Hirschsprung's). Please perform an Anorectal Manometry and Abdominal X-Ray immediately to confirm.
